ANIMA 易用工作流程 v1

用于 ANIMA 生成的简单一体化 ComfyUI 工作流程。

可用语言：英语、韩语、日语、中文。

用户指南

此工作流程旨在通过将主要生成设置组织为几个简单的节点，使 ANIMA 更易于在 ComfyUI 中使用。

您可以通过一个紧凑的工作流程管理提示、LoRA 预设、模型选择、采样、高分辨率、细节设计、预览和保存。

主要特点

  • 简单的 ANIMA 生成流程使用 Easy Use Anima 节点

  • 提示工作室高级版 v2用于有组织的提示字段、否定提示、通配符支持和标签友好的编辑

  • LoRA预设用于保存和加载带有触发字的 LoRA 堆栈

  • 易于使用的动画输入用于选择 ANIMA 扩散模型、VAE 和文本编码器

  • 一体式发电机用于采样器设置、高分辨率、细节、预览和图像保存

  • 工作流元数据支持使用图像保护程序时

推荐首次运行

  1. 安装所需的模型和自定义节点。

  2. 在 ComfyUI 中加载工作流程。

  3. 检查型号选择易于使用的动画输入.

  4. 如果缺少任何 LoRA 示例，请禁用该 LoRA 行或使用修复如果文件名仍然可用，则函数。

  5. 在中输入您的主要提示一般标签的领域提示工作室高级版 v2.

  6. 对于第一次测试，请保留高分辨率和细节师关闭。

  7. 基本生成正常工作后，根据需要启用 Highres、Detailer、DAVE 或优化选项。

所需的模型文件

此工作流程不会将 ANIMA 作为单个检查点加载。请分别选择扩散模型、VAE和文本编码器易于使用的动画输入.

  • anima-base-v1.0.safetensors — 放置在ComfyUI/模型/diffusion_models/

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors — 放置在ComfyUI/模型/vae/

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors — 放置在ComfyUI/模型/text_encoders/

型号页面：Circlestone 实验室/Anima

所需的自定义节点

  • ComfyUI-EasyUseAnima — 主要工作流程节点

  • ComfyUI-Spectrum-KSampler — 采样器后端和频谱优化

  • ComfyUI-图像保护程序 — WebP 保存、工作流程嵌入和元数据保存

可选/推荐的自定义节点

  • ComfyUI-Lora-Manager — LoRA触发词和元数据管理

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes — SageAttention、Torch Compile 和 FP16 累积选项

  • ComfyUI 冲击包 — SAM3、MaskToSEGS 和 Detailer 支持

  • ComfyUI-Anima-DAVE — 可选型号补丁，可实现更多代品种

注释

  • 示例工作流程中包含的 LoRA 不是必需的。它们仅用于样本风格再现。

  • 如果工作流程在第一次运行时失败，请尝试先禁用 Highres 和 Detailer，然后逐一启用额外功能。

  • 如果采样器或调度程序值丢失，请更新或重新安装 ComfyUI-Spectrum-KSampler。

  • 如果 Image Saver 导致错误，请检查 ComfyUI-Image-Saver 是否安装并在“保存选项”中正确选择。

友情链接

  • ComfyUI-EasyUseAnima GitHub

  • 工作流程指南

ANIMA Easy Use Workflow v1

A simple all-in-one ComfyUI workflow for ANIMA generation.

Available languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese.

User Guide

This workflow is designed to make ANIMA easier to use in ComfyUI by organizing the main generation setup into a few simple nodes.

You can manage prompts, LoRA presets, model selection, sampling, Highres, Detailer, preview, and saving from one compact workflow.

Main Features

  • Simple ANIMA generation flowusing Easy Use Anima nodes

  • Prompt Studio Advanced v2for organized prompt fields, negative prompts, wildcard support, and tag-friendly editing

  • LoRA Presetfor saving and loading LoRA stacks with trigger words

  • Easy Use Anima Inputfor selecting the ANIMA diffusion model, VAE, and text encoder

  • AiO Generatorfor sampler settings, Highres, Detailer, preview, and image saving

  • Workflow metadata supportwhen using Image Saver

Recommended First Run

  1. Install the required models and custom nodes.

  2. Load the workflow in ComfyUI.

  3. Check the model selections inEasy Use Anima Input.

  4. If any sample LoRA is missing, disable that LoRA row or use theFIXfunction if the file name is still available.

  5. Enter your main prompt in theGeneral Tagsfield ofPrompt Studio Advanced v2.

  6. For the first test, keepHighresandDetailerturned off.

  7. After basic generation works correctly, enable Highres, Detailer, DAVE, or optimization options as needed.

Required Model Files

This workflow does not load ANIMA as a single checkpoint. Please select the diffusion model, VAE, and text encoder separately inEasy Use Anima Input.

  • anima-base-v1.0.safetensors — place inComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

  • qwen_image_vae.safetensors — place inComfyUI/models/vae/

  • qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors — place inComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

Model page:circlestone-labs/Anima

Required Custom Nodes

  • ComfyUI-EasyUseAnima — main workflow nodes

  • ComfyUI-Spectrum-KSampler — sampler backend and Spectrum optimization

  • ComfyUI-Image-Saver — WebP saving, workflow embed, and metadata saving

Optional / Recommended Custom Nodes

  • ComfyUI-Lora-Manager — LoRA trigger word and metadata management

  • ComfyUI-KJNodes — SageAttention, Torch Compile, and FP16 accumulation options

  • ComfyUI-Impact-Pack — SAM3, MaskToSEGS, and Detailer support

  • ComfyUI-Anima-DAVE — optional model patch for more generation variety

Notes

  • The LoRAs included in the sample workflow are not required. They are only used for sample style reproduction.

  • If the workflow fails on the first run, try disabling Highres and Detailer first, then enable extra features one by one.

  • If a sampler or scheduler value is missing, update or reinstall ComfyUI-Spectrum-KSampler.

  • If Image Saver causes an error, check whether ComfyUI-Image-Saver is installed and selected correctly in Save Options.
